questions.question: In the expression $a\times b=ab\text{,}$ what is the result called?
questions.explanation: Multiplication combines the two factors $a$ and $b$ to produce $a\times b\text{,}$ also written $ab\text{.}$ This result is called their product.

An exponent is the raised number in a power such as $a^b\text{;}$ it is not the name of $ab$ as a product.
